Some people believe that technology has made our lives more complicated, while others think it has made life easier. In my opinion, although technology introduces new challenges, its benefits clearly outweigh its drawbacks.

On the one hand, it is true that modern devices can be a source of stress. For example, many workers feel they must answer emails at all hours, and this constant connection can blur the line between work and rest. In addition, learning to use new tools takes time and effort, which some older people in particular find frustrating.

On the other hand, technology saves us an enormous amount of time in daily tasks. Online banking, for instance, means we no longer have to queue for hours, and video calls allow families separated by long distances to stay close. These conveniences free up time for the activities that matter most to us.

In conclusion, while technology does create some difficulties, I firmly believe that the advantages it brings to communication and efficiency make our lives far easier overall.
